ShortDescription.Value: Play however your brain wants. The mod remembers the rest.

Publish.LongDescription:
# ADHD Gone Wild — seems about right.
Ever started fixing a roundabout… and ended up with three half-built metro lines, half a park, the beginning of a harbor, and no memory of the original problem?
Ever opened one panel… and suddenly the whole screen was yelling at you?
Ever played for “five more minutes”… and somehow it’s tomorrow?
No productivity hacks. No focus police. No forcing your brain into a checklist.
ADHD Gone Wild clears the noise, remembers the loose ends, and lets your brain wander wherever it wants.
## What it does
* **Park an idea** - Ctrl+I, then click anywhere. A ring marks the spot; click the ring later and it opens. * **One short list** instead of the same warning on forty buildings. Mute anything you would rather not hear about, and unmute it whenever you like. * **A safety net** - one click saves a way back before you try something, one click returns. * **Welcome back** - where you were, and what you left there. * **A calmer screen** - map icons stop pulsing, and the build toolbar folds away. * **Reminds you to drink water** - while you are hyperfocusing. It never suggests stopping. * **Where was I?** - an optional, session-only trail of places where you spent time.
Everything can be switched off on its own. Nothing is written into your save games.
**Please leave a comment.** What helps, what gets in the way, what you wish it did. And if you have ADHD, how any of this actually lands for you - that is worth more to me than a bug report, because it is the part I cannot work out on my own.
## Thanks
To Sumarra who took the screenshots on this page.
And to my girlfriend, and to her ADHD. Between them they shaped this mod far more than I did.
